title: Blood and Silk: Power and Conflict in Modern Southeast Asia
author: Michael Vatikiotis

edition.title: Blood and Silk

edition.subtitle: Power and Conflict in Modern Southeast Asia

notes.value: Source title: Blood and Silk: Power and Conflict in Modern Southeast Asia

description.value: Thought-provoking and eye-opening, BLOOD AND SILK is an accessible, personal look at modern Southeast Asia, written by one of the region's most experienced outside observers. This is a first-hand account of what it's like to sit at the table with deadly Thai Muslim insurgents, mediate between warring clans in the Southern Philippines and console the victims of political violence in Indonesia - all in an effort to negotiate peace, and understand the reasons behind endemic violence.
